author: Carthage411
title: A Mountain to Climb
content:
As someone who has played this game for over 2 years now, my advice is: TURN BACK! The developers have cut almost every single helpful tool in the game. Daily challenges? Impossible to complete at later stages because you have to complete tasks. A single task in the Perfumery (where I am currently at) takes OVER A DAY to complete. And mind you, there are literal HUNDREDS of tasks in a single area, save the very beginning to bait you into playing. Side quests and events? Don’t bother. They usually just hand out a handful of exp and coins (which are WORTHLESS), with occasional decoration sets that are impossible to complete without paying. Photo sets? Again, impossible. They set the odds of the “winning” photo of the set to practically zero. You literally have a better chance of being struck by lightning than collecting them all. And the paid packs? Don’t even get me started. They used to cost 6.99. That was still pricey, but you could easily clear to level 50 where 2 Boulton cards were, as well as 8 hour skips, 20 minute infinite energy, and a handful of gems and other things. You also had 30 days to get all the good stuff before it reset. Now? They are 12.99 at TWO paid tiers, 5 minute infinite energy, 2-4 hour time skips, and even playing DAILY you will barely be able to crack level 40, locking you out of the Boulton cards, which are the ONLY reason to buy the packs. And they now reset after only 20 days. Now I’ll only buy the packs if I’m desperate for gems. It’s cheaper than buying them directly. For now, at least. Only bought one in the last 6 months. 

Levels get harder to complete the further you go as the items you have to merge more and more frequently are max level. Everything past the Museum is nothing but a slog, taking MONTHS to complete a single area. Sometimes you’ll go days without completing a single task. The wretched level 12 weaves are the worst. They will take you over a week just to make a single one. I see moths in my nightmares now. The first bedroom in the game takes four of them to complete the area plus LITERALLY 200 more tasks. You do the math there. While I admit, the game can technically be beaten without spending a dime, it would take literal DECADES of your life to do so. Just take my advice: enjoy the first few areas of the game, and after you hit the pool area, uninstall the game. Do not give these developers your valuable time and money, as they have proven time and again they will cut EVERY CORNER POSSIBLE to squeeze another dime out of you. Once I complete the final wing in the main mansion, I’m done. I think I have about 6 or so areas to go. Out of around 50. The game goes on after that. They added a factory and they’ll probably use the boat in the garden for another area in the future. I signed up to renovate a mansion. That’s what I’m going to do, and then I’m getting out. 

Oh, and by the way, you don’t start the game fixing up the mansion. You’ll have to play for about a YEAR before you even step foot inside. And the story is so bland and slow that by the time something actually relevant happened I stopped paying attention. 

At least they haven’t implemented a gacha system. Yet. I wouldn’t put it past them, though. The moment they do I’m out, finished mansion or not. Better than most phone slop in that department at least.

author: spotts7
title: Please Fix This
content: I have been playing this game for several years now. I am on Maddie’s Room Level for reference. I purchase the newer “3-Tiered Season Pass”, if you will. You can earn more rewards this way and level up quicker. In recent months, however, you all took away the Producer Machine at the end of a Season Pass. This makes it virtually impossible to get to the 50 Tier and the proceeding 5 Treasure Chests with even higher valued rewards. Like the coveted Black Energy Card that upgrades any Producer Item on the Main Playing Board. You also have to purchase gems more frequently to have enough energy for Bonus Games like the Fishing and Bird Watching. Because even if you earn a few here or there from your Golden Piggy Bank, you’re never going to earn gems without purchasing them. To explain further, you get 50 Purple or Pink Lives to start with depending on the Bonus Event. After those lives, there are 5 Free lives under the little Shop Button (which only refresh every few hours). You must spend gems for more energy to collect more items within the Event. It starts at 10 gems for 50 more lives which is totally reasonable, then it asks you to spend 20 gems — sure; whatever. Then it gets high. It starts asking for 40 gems, 80 gems, 120, 240 and you can get the picture. I am not spending 160 gems for more energy, then 240 and higher. That’s greedy. What is the point? You’re never going to reach those higher rewards in the Bonus Games. They’re abysmal, unless you’re willing to fork out the cash and buy gems for lives. This game is supposed to be enjoyable and some of the prices for Gems and Bundles is out of this world. More than gas, are you serious?! Other Bonus Games cost Blue Lives and those are tied directly to Main Board Lives. This whole Game Industry has turned is quite the money grab and I’m disappointed that Merge Mansion is participating in this. I have spent $100’s of dollars on this game. Which was my own choice, however, I can’t justify it any longer. You all fixed the absurdity of spending 100’s of gems to purchase energy on the Main Board, it no longer costs 160+ gems and so on to get more energy. It reaches a maximum of 40 gems for 100 energy until after 12:00pm and then it resets to 5, 10, 20, and 40. So thank you for that. However, I’m not wasting $2-$14+ to buy more gems when I want to collect all of my Fish Medals in a Bonus Game. You run through that within minutes for a measly 100-150 more lives. That is a waste of time and money. I’m mostly irked by the fact that the Season Pass is now a gimmick. Please fix this. And please stop moving around the Trade-In items tab. With the last update it did go back to its own tab on the top left screen. That was extremely helpful. It’s nothing more than annoying when things keep switching around the platform. This game is my form of relaxing after work or on break. Now it feels like a money-grab. Considering deleting this app altogether. Which would be a shame considering how much time and actual money I’ve put into this game. Food for thought. You’re about to lose a lot of loyal players.

author: Horiztar
title: A once-great game losing its way
content:
Merge Mansion used to be a genuinely fun and well-paced game two or three years ago. The progression felt rewarding, the events were worth participating in, and the game gave players a reason to stay engaged.

In recent years, however, many of the new features have felt more like distractions than real improvements. They may look varied on the surface, but the actual rewards are often so poor that I have started ignoring most of them. Instead of making the core gameplay deeper or more interesting, the game keeps adding side systems that feel increasingly restrictive.

What is most disappointing is that player rewards have been reduced again and again. In the past, putting serious effort into the season pass or limited-time events could occasionally earn meaningful rewards, such as a Blue Card. Now the developers seem to be making those rewards significantly harder to obtain. Recent weekly tasks have also raised the completion requirements by a large margin, making the game feel more demanding while giving less in return.

This is not meaningful difficulty or better game design. It feels like the game is slowly taking away value from loyal players while presenting it as new content or variety. The result is a game that feels less generous, less rewarding, and less enjoyable than it used to be.

Merge Mansion was once a game I truly enjoyed. Now it feels like a game that keeps asking for more while giving players less.

author: Landon is mushrooms
title: Game is going downhill
content:
I have played this game for over two years and I have enjoyed it, even spent a little money here and there on it. The story mode is very long and there are lots of side mini-games to add to gameplay.

That being said, recent changes have caused problems that are hard to overlook. Those problems are, in order to of severity (high to low) are:

1. Server stability

Over the years there have been little glitches that cause the game to crash or the servers to be down, this is expected. They were always fixed quickly. Recently, however, it just seems like the game isn’t stable. You start playing only to have the game crash or the server disconnect, and when you finally get connected again all the things you did are gone and you have to re-do them. I gave this situation a couple MONTHS to go away, but they still persist. It’s time to get it fixed.

2. Incessant need to stay connected

This game pings more than it should need to, and this leads to #1. There is no reason losing the connection for 30 seconds should force you out, especially when it’s your own server’s fault that the connection fails.

3. Ridiculous order requirements

As you progress you will get to a point where almost every order requires ridiculously expensive items. Be prepared to slog through or shell out some serious dough to proceed. Money is the only way to keep up with the additions.

4. Competitive mini-games

I, for one, don’t play games like this for multiplayer, I prefer to work alone. Some of these give decent rewards, though, so sometimes they’re worth playing. But almost every one of them has a trick to them that many players exploit, and obviously those willing to spend will typically win.

5. Constantly changing merge trees

As you go along, you will end up “maxing out” certain items’ merge trees. Later, they add NEW items into those trees, which is annoying because you probably stopped collecting those a long time ago, and now suddenly you need to start collecting them again (and when space in your grid is at a premium, who wants to do that???) It would be better to just add new item trees.

6. Constantly conflicting resources

Some paths (I’m talking about YOU, cryptex!) require you to gather a ridiculously high level of a time consuming item to make… and then jobs keep requiring that you USE those same items. It basically ensures that you MUST spend BIG money if you want to unlock that area, or just chalk it up that you’re basically never going to get there. So this part is pretty clearly a cash grab.

7. New layouts and features you didn’t ask for

…and as expected these cause confusion and sometimes hinder gameplay. The layout was fine for years, why change it? Why crowd things on the top bar so I have to scroll back and forth to find things? I personally hate auto merge and I’m afraid in the new configuration that I’m going to enter the grid at some point and it’s going to auto-merge things I didn’t want merged because it turned on by default. Stop adding things that haven’t been asked for.

I don’t mind the energy mechanic and I don’t mind waiting sometimes for things to finish, so I always liked this game. These new situations are making me re-think of this as my primary time waster.
